title: Multifractal aspects of $α$-expansions
summary: In \cite{[NE]} we introduce $α$-expansions a real numbers in $(0,1]$, given by \[ \sum_{i=1}^{\infty}(α-1)^{i-1}α^{-(d_{1}+\dots+d_{i})}\] with $α>1$ and $d_{i}\in\mathbb{N}$ and discuss ergodic theoretical and dimension theoretical aspects of this expansions. In this sequel we study mutifractal aspects of this expansions.
